en.title: Wapp Store
en.summary: Browse, install, and update wapps from repositories
en.body: The central store for discovering and installing geogram wapps. Add repository URLs to browse available wapps, install with one tap, and receive update notifications when new versions are published.

pt.title: Loja de Wapps
pt.summary: Navegue, instale e atualize wapps de repositorios
pt.body: A loja central para descobrir e instalar wapps geogram. Adicione URLs de repositorios para navegar wapps disponiveis, instale com um toque e receba notificacoes quando novas versoes sao publicadas.

de.title: Wapp Store
de.summary: Wapps aus Repositories durchsuchen, installieren und aktualisieren
de.body: Der zentrale Store zum Entdecken und Installieren von geogram-Wapps. Repository-URLs hinzufuegen, verfuegbare Wapps durchsuchen, mit einem Klick installieren und Update-Benachrichtigungen erhalten.

changelog:
## 1.0.0
- Multi-source repository support
- Install and update wapps
- Publisher verification via NOSTR signatures
